Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + 30-min preview time options

Thanks again for the chat today — great to learn more about VerdantHQ's ingestion pipeline and the latency/throughput constraints you're tracking. Per our discovery, the two things that matter most for your evaluation are: 1) predictable token-cost at scale, and 2) a path to private deployment (VPC) for regulated data.

Proposed next step: a focused 30-minute product preview (short demo + ops Q&A) to show the streaming behavior and the Dedicated capacity options. Below are three windows that should work for our team next week (times are PT):

- Option A — Wed Mar 17, 9:30–10:00 PT
- Option B — Wed Mar 17, 13:00–13:30 PT
- Option C — Thu Mar 18, 10:00–10:30 PT

Attendees from our side: me (product), Jordan Blake (solutions engineer) for the technical deep dive.

Attachments: deck-briefing-v1.pdf (30-slide preview), security-questions.xlsx (your SOC 2 checklist if useful).

Ask: can you confirm the best option and who from VerdantHQ should join (security/infra SME + a product stakeholder preferred)? If helpful I can include a short mutual action plan in the calendar invite.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
